app_info.subtitle: Build and evolve Grist Community applications
app_info.description: Inspect, structure and evolve documents on a configured self-hosted Grist Community deployment through ten bounded semantic MCP tools for data, schema, pages and widgets. Native Grist permissions remain authoritative, and credentials and secrets stay server-side. Independent project; not affiliated with Grist Labs, DINUM or OpenAI.

justifications.read_only_justification: Discover Grist resources only retrieves or computes Grist information and does not change Grist user state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Discover Grist resources is confined to the configured Grist deployment and the principal's bounded documents or workspaces; it does not access arbitrary public Internet entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Discover Grist resources performs no write and therefore cannot destructively change Grist user state.

test_cases.description: Inspect a synthetic reviewer document without unnecessary row disclosure.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the synthetic Grist document identified in the reviewer instructions and summarize its tables, columns, relationships, pages and widgets without reading table records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected synthetic document and normalized table, column, relationship, page and widget metadata without user-table rows or data changes.

test_cases.description: Filter and limit synthetic records, including a no-match query.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the reviewer document, inspect ReviewTasks columns, then show at most two tasks whose Status is Open, sorted by Title; also search Title for NoSuchSyntheticTask.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns at most two matching tasks in Title order and no records for the nonexistent title, without modifying Grist data.

test_cases.description: Create bounded records and verify independently.
test_cases.user_prompt: In ReviewTasks in the reviewer document, create two synthetic tasks titled Review Alpha and Review Beta with Status Open, then read them back using the returned IDs.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the two new record IDs and verifies their stored Title and Status; any partial or ambiguous write is surfaced without blindly replaying the request.

test_cases.description: Create and verify a bounded synthetic schema.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the reviewer document, create a ReviewMetrics table with an Amount numeric column and a DoubleAmount numeric formula column using $Amount * 2 with label Double amount, then verify the table and column metadata.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the new table and column identifiers and verifies the requested numeric types, formula and label without changing unrelated schema.

test_cases.description: Create a page and configure a safe direct select-by link.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the reviewer document, create an empty page called Review dashboard for ReviewTasks, add two record widgets for that table, link the second widget to the first with direct select-by, and verify the page and link.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the page and widget IDs and verifies the direct select-by link by re-read; an ambiguous write result is not blindly replayed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for unrelated calendar access.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings are on my personal calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Grist tools because personal calendar access is outside this plugin's bounded Grist workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for arbitrary HTTP forwarding.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch https://example.com and forward its raw response through the Grist plugin.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Grist tools or perform HTTP forwarding; explains that arbitrary external URL fetching or relay is unsupported.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for Grist account or ACL administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Grist user and grant them administrator access to my workspace.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Grist tools because account creation and permission administration are outside the bounded MCP surface.
